summary: Tested public backend APIs and desktop/mobile UI for dashboard, stock filtering/search, quick inward/outward posting, ledger visibility, and responsive overflow.

critical.issue: Seeded inventory rows have no rate field, while dashboard inventory_value sums available * rate; the seeded KPI returned inventory_value=0.

ui_bugs.issue: Filter icon button is rendered but has no onClick behavior or filtering panel.

issues: Header title wraps tightly beside the Stock Out action; visually cramped although no horizontal overflow was detected.

action_items: Populate seeded inventory rate from product purchase_rate or calculate inventory value by joining inventory to products.
Either implement the stock filter button or remove it until it has behavior.
Use the fetched /api/ledger response for Movement Ledger instead of dashboard.transactions when ledger history can exceed 20 records.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard inventory_value currently depends on an inventory.rate field that seed() never writes, making the initial KPI misleading.
Transaction IDs use count_documents()+1 and can collide under concurrent posts; use a database-safe sequence or collision-resistant ID strategy if concurrent admins are later supported.
TransactionIn permits an empty items list, allowing zero-quantity posted movements; enforce a non-empty list and positive aggregate quantity.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-prefixed inward transaction through the API and one UI_TEST inward plus one UI_TEST outward transaction; no master records created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core public API and UI flows pass. Recheck dashboard inventory value from a clean seeded database, then verify ledger behavior beyond 20 transactions and the stock filter control.
rca of the issue: The dashboard sums inventory documents using x.get('rate', 0), but seed() inserts inventory without rate and stores product pricing only in products. Therefore all untouched seeded inventory contributes zero to inventory_value. The API/UI posting tests otherwise passed: 3/4 backend tests passed, and all exercised UI flows passed.
